أقتضي (form VIII)
# أَقْتَضِي (ʔaqtaḍī) /ʔaq.ta.dˤiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# أَقْتَضِيَ (ʔaqtaḍiya) /ʔaq.ta.dˤi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
